svg.text: Adding matter walks the spiral's exponents onto the circle-op values {2, 4}; graviton loops are the 1/N break
Purple: the UV exponents of the EH flow
Blue rings: the values a pair of circle-op
Pure gravity sits far off the axis.
Matter loops pull the pair down to the
axis and onto the rings; the leftover
So the circle-op structure is exactly
the large-N limit, and graviton loops
Illustrative hybrid: Litim graviton terms (parent page) + Donà–Eichhorn–Percacci matter coefficients (their eqs. 35–36). Endpoint {4, 2} and λ* = 3/8 agree with their Table II.
Gray dots: published pure-gravity EH exponents for five cutoffs (Codello–Percacci–Rahmede 2008). Checks L8, L9.
